subject: URGENT: Course Selection for Semester 2 closes 30 Sep 2026 – action required
body:
Dear Student,

This is a reminder that the add/drop and course selection period for Semester 2, 2026-27 will close on 30 September 2026 at 23:59 (HKT).

You are required to confirm your course list in SIS before the deadline. Students who fail to confirm will have their unconfirmed courses removed automatically.

Action required:
1. Log in to HKU Portal > SIS > Course Selection
2. Confirm your enrolled courses for Semester 2
3. Reply to this email if you encounter any enrolment problems

Please note that late applications will not be accepted.

Registry, The University of Hong Kong

subject: COMP7801 Assignment 2 — submission deadline extended to 3 Oct 2026
body:
Hi all,

Due to the public holiday next week, the deadline of Assignment 2 has been extended to 3 October 2026, 23:59. Please submit via Moodle as usual.

A few of you have asked about the runtime complexity requirement in Question 3 — you may assume the distance matrix is dense and that O(n^2 log n) is acceptable.

Please reply to me directly if you need an extension for medical reasons, and attach supporting documents.

Best regards,
K. W. Chan

subject: [CEDARS] Career Fair 2026 — Registration opens, limited seats
body:
Dear Students,

We are pleased to invite you to the HKU Career Fair 2026, to be held on 15 October 2026 at the Grand Hall, Centennial Campus.

Over 80 companies from technology, finance and consulting will be recruiting on-site. Pre-registration is required as seats are limited and will be allocated on a first-come-first-served basis.

Registration deadline: 10 October 2026
Register here: https://cedars.hku.hk/careerfair2026

Bring your student card for check-in.

CEDARS — Centre of Development and Resources for Students

subject: Reminder: Please complete the Annual IT Security Awareness Training by 15 Oct 2026
body:
Dear Colleagues and Students,

All HKU members are required to complete the Annual IT Security Awareness Training by 15 October 2026. The course takes approximately 30 minutes.

Access the training at https://itsc.hku.hk/training using your HKU Portal UID and PIN.

If you have already completed the training, please disregard this message.

Information Technology Services

subject: HKU Libraries — Scheduled system maintenance 29 Sep 22:00-02:00
body:
Dear Library Users,

Please be informed that the Library online services (book renewal, e-resource access and room booking) will be unavailable from 22:00 on 29 September to 02:00 on 30 September 2026 for scheduled maintenance.

We apologise for any inconvenience caused.

HKU Libraries

subject: Invitation: MSc Seminar Series — Generative AI in Software Engineering, 8 Oct
body:
Dear Students,

The Faculty of Engineering cordially invites you to a seminar on Generative AI in Software Engineering, delivered by Prof. L. Chen, on 8 October 2026 (Thursday), 16:30-18:00, in Lecture Theatre A, Chow Yei Ching Building.

Please RSVP by 6 October 2026 so that we can arrange seating: https://engg.hku.hk/events/genai-seminar

Light refreshments will be served.

Faculty of Engineering

subject: Your HKU Portal password will expire in 7 days
body:
Your HKU Portal password will expire on 5 October 2026. Please change it before the expiry date to avoid service interruption.

Change your password at https://portal.hku.hk/password

Do not reply to this automated message.

subject: Important: Confirm your dissertation supervisor by 20 Oct 2026
body:
Dear Student,

You are required to confirm your dissertation supervisor and submit the signed confirmation form by 20 October 2026. Please discuss with your proposed supervisor and return the completed form to the Graduate School.

Please reply to this email if you have not yet identified a supervisor.

Graduate School, The University of Hong Kong

subject: Re: Group project meeting — need your slides by Thursday
body:
Hi,

Just checking in — can you send me your part of the slides by Thursday so I can merge everything before the rehearsal?

Also, we still need to decide who presents the evaluation section. Let me know what you think.

Thanks!
Wing Yan

subject: Moodle maintenance notice — 30 Sep 2026
body:

Information Technology Services

subject: Scholarship application — deadline 12 Oct 2026, submit your documents
body:
Dear Student,

Applications for the 2026-27 Outstanding Student Scholarship are now open. The application deadline is 12 October 2026.

To apply, please submit the completed application form together with your transcript and one referee report through https://scholarships.hku.hk/apply.

Incomplete applications will not be considered. Please reply to this email if you have questions about eligibility.

Scholarships Office
